cases.name: anonymous terminal extra aliases remain separators
named terminal extra aliases retain public names
private scanner extra expressions preserve skipped prefixes and committed state
cases.listing:
(grammar (start document))
(extra (seq (ref _line)))
(scanner line (tokens _line) (operations (if (equal (depth pending) (integer 0)) (then fail)) (while (next (literal %20)) (do (skip (literal %20)))) (consume (literal %0A)) (pop pending) (emit _line)))
(rule opening token (literal %5B) (action (push pending (integer 1))))
(rule document normal (seq (ref opening) (predicate (literal x) (equal (depth pending) (integer 0)))))

cases.name: public scanner extras preserve independent prefix and token spans
cases.listing:
(grammar (start document))
(extra (ref annotation))
(scanner line (tokens annotation) (operations (if (equal (depth pending) (integer 0)) (then fail)) (while (next (literal %20)) (do (skip (literal %20)))) (consume (literal %0A)) (pop pending) (emit annotation)))
(rule opening token (literal %5B) (action (push pending (integer 1))))
(rule document normal (seq (ref opening) (predicate (literal x) (equal (depth pending) (integer 0)))))
